# INC-2019-07: cache cluster down 52 minutes

When the cache cluster rebooted, every API pod retried Get() in a tight loop with no cap. Load on the cluster went 40x and it stayed down for 52 minutes.

Action item: cap retries and add backoff (done in the cache client). Do not remove the cap.
